integrity: A self-contained proof of all parameter regimes and all optimal centers is provided. Exact-rational finite tests support rather than establish the infinite-family claim; no independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns ordinary intrinsic Minkowski asymmetry of finite loopless rank-two matroid base polytopes only. It does not address higher rank; equivalent earlier formulations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Minkowski asymmetry and all centers of rank-two matroid base polytopes
